status_note: WORKPKG-UNMAP-RULEADJ-0013 B2 fixture for the last .cc-side straggler RuleSignMod2nOpt2::checkMultiequalForm (ruleaction.cc:8941-8985, previously deferred for lack of block-structure access). Drives RuleSignMod2nOpt2::applyOp on the MULTIEQUAL path V=(V s<0)?V+2^n-1:V over the oracle's compiled diamond (decision D -> inner N -> merge M plus D -> M direct edge; M's other in-edge must BE the decision block, cc:8960-8972). Edge order (add_edge call order) is the semantics under test: M.in=[N,D] vs [D,N] picks innerSlot, D.out=[M,N] vs [N,M] with boolean_flip picks negSlot via getTrueOut()/getFalseOut() (block.hh:299-300 positional). Positive cases: slot0/slot1, no-flip/flip, and the oracle LAXITY that cc:8975-8982 never compares lessOp in(0) against base (me_lax_sless_in0 accepts INT_SLESS on an unrelated varnode). Rejects: wrong add constant, other MULTIEQUAL base, inner with extra out-edge (no 1-in/1-out M in-edge), no diamond (E->M instead of D->M), non-CBRANCH last op, sless constant != 0, negative-branch slot mismatch under flip, 3-input MULTIEQUAL. The fixture exposed and closed a pre-existing operator-precedence defect: ruleaction.rs computed npow as !(x+1) instead of (!x)+1 (oracle cc:8883 ~constVn->getOffset()+1), which had silently disabled BOTH RuleSignMod2nOpt2 paths on every input (npow never came out a correct power of two except x=mask).

decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: slot/innerSlot/negSlot are per-call locals with no cross-call state; npow is a per-call value parameter mutated once at entry.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: Varnode pointer equality (otherBase==base, bl->getIn(1-innerSlot)==decision, negBlock==inner); offset equality constVn->getOffset()==npow-1 and lessOp in(1)==0; npow = (~andConst+1)&mask two's-complement negation with popcount==1 and !=1 gates; negSlot=(negBlock==inner)?innerSlot:1-innerSlot must equal the INT_ADD slot.
